column1: # The frozen C++ dial path (Ruling A, 2026-10-08). Every body and calls row
# is a function the P2P-3 slice 3 cutover deletes. Until that PR, a change to
# a row's body fails `check_dial_path_freeze.py`; deleting the function
# passes, where deleted means the bare name is gone from src/p2p outside
# comments and literals. The two shrink rows are the files that may not grow
# (Rick, 2026-10-08): a change may not raise their count of non-blank,
# non-comment lines. This file is the list the dialer brief's deletion table
# The one exception is a line in the dialer brief, new in the PR, of exactly
# this form, naming the row's full anchor or the shrink row's file path:
# When the cutover has deleted every function here, it empties this file,
# and the gate reports the freeze discharged.
#   kind   body   the function from its anchor to its closing brace
#          calls  the lines inside that function that call the fourth column
#          shrink the file's code-line count may not go up
#   anchor the definition's qualified name up to its opening parenthesis;
#          it must occur once in the file (body and calls rows)
#   callee (calls rows only) the function those frozen lines call
